server.description: A factory task's own files: list, read, write, inside the task's directory and nowhere above
server.instructions: Every path is relative to the task's directory; nothing above it is reachable. Write what you build here, with its name; the runtime reads documents from here by name.

list.title: List a task's files
list.description: The files of a task's directory (or one of its folders): path, bytes, sha256, last modification. Empty for a task with no file yet.

properties.taskId: the task whose directory this is (from factory.request)
properties.path: a folder of the task; the whole task when absent

read.title: Read one file of a task
read.description: The content of one file of the task, as text (or base64 for a binary), with its size and sha256. 256 KB at most per read; a bigger file is refused with its size.

properties.path: a path relative to the task's directory
properties.maxBytes: refuse above this many bytes (256 KB at most)

write.title: Write one file of a task
write.description: Write a file in the task's directory (folders are created); text or base64. A file that existed is replaced and the sha256 of the previous content is recorded. Returns the new size and sha256.

properties.path: a path relative to the task's directory
properties.base64: the content, base64, for a binary

workspace://writes.name: Writes
workspace://writes.description: Every write this slot made: task, path, bytes, sha256, and the sha256 of the previous content when a file was replaced
